frame.name: ECLIPJ2000 (geocentric origin)
frame.description: Ecliptic and equinox of J2000. +X toward the J2000 equinox, +Z toward the north ecliptic pole. Not the ecliptic of date.

model.time_scale_note: UTC at the API boundary; converted to ET (TDB seconds past J2000) by SPICE str2et with the leap-second kernel.
model.nominal_accuracy: JPL DE440 ephemeris through CSPICE; geometric positions (no light-time or aberration correction). Not validated against JPL Horizons for this endpoint.

assumptions: Positions are geometric (no light-time, no aberration): consistent for placing bodies in a scene; the apparent directions of a lunar site come from the scenario evaluation.
Illuminated fraction k = (1 + cos i)/2 with i the Sun-Moon-Earth phase angle (spherical Moon, no terrain).
Moon orientation: MOON_ME (mean Earth / polar axis, DE440 lunar orientation, librations included).
Earth orientation (texture only): IAU rotation model of pck00011.tpc (IAU_EARTH); no polar motion, no UT1-UTC.
